Datasheet values along the path: CHV-1-1—6000 psig (413 bar); E-6-1—10.3 barg (ASME) or 16.0 barg (PED); LV-6-1—no single valve maximum stated (104 bar/1500 psig is a packing-system limit); BV-6-1—no single maximum stated; E-6-2—10.3 barg (ASME) or 16.0 barg (PED); FV-6-2—no single valve maximum stated (104 bar/1500 psig is a packing-system limit); CHV-6-1—6000 psig (413 bar); P-6-1—250 psi (1723 kPa) maximum operating pressure, 266 psi (1834 kPa) casing pressure; PV-6-3—no single valve maximum stated (104 bar/1500 psig is a packing-system limit); GV-6-4—6 bar; P-9-1—250 psi (1723 kPa) maximum operating pressure, 266 psi (1834 kPa) casing pressure; E-9-1—10.3 barg (ASME) or 16.0 barg (PED); BV-9-1—no single maximum stated; BV-9-2—no single maximum stated; E-9-2—10.3 barg (ASME) or 16.0 barg (PED); CHV-9-2—6000 psig (413 bar); P-14-1—250 psi (1723 kPa) maximum operating pressure, 266 psi (1834 kPa) casing pressure; FV-14-1—no single valve maximum stated (104 bar/1500 psig is a packing-system limit); P-14-2—250 psi (1723 kPa) maximum operating pressure, 266 psi (1834 kPa) casing pressure; CHV-14-1—6000 psig (413 bar); P-14-3—250 psi (1723 kPa) maximum operating pressure, 266 psi (1834 kPa) casing pressure; GV-14-2—6 bar; GV-14-3—6 bar; P-14-6—250 psi (1723 kPa) maximum operating pressure, 266 psi (1834 kPa) casing pressure.
